sql: WITH appearances AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.year,r.round,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) JOIN status st USING(status_id) WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959 AND st.status NOT IN ('Did not qualify','Did not prequalify','Did not start','Did not race') AND NOT(st.status='Withdrew' AND COALESCE(re.laps,0)=0)), bounds AS (SELECT year,driver_id,MIN(round) first_round,MAX(round) last_round,COUNT(DISTINCT round) rounds FROM appearances GROUP BY year,driver_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round)>=2), eligible AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.year,b.driver_id,b.first_round,b.last_round,b.rounds,a.constructor_id FROM bounds b JOIN appearances a ON a.year=b.year AND a.driver_id=b.driver_id AND a.round=b.first_round JOIN appearances z ON z.year=b.year AND z.driver_id=b.driver_id AND z.round=b.last_round AND z.constructor_id=a.constructor_id) SELECT e.year,d.forename,d.surname,e.first_round,e.last_round,e.rounds,c.name endpoint_constructor,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mid.constructor_id) all_constructors FROM eligible e JOIN appearances mid ON mid.year=e.year AND mid.driver_id=e.driver_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=e.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=e.constructor_id GROUP BY e.year,e.driver_id,e.constructor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mid.constructor_id)>1 ORDER BY e.year,e.driver_id
